claim: Hashing convention covers every packaged file; manifest reproduces from a clean checkout
finding: The canonical-LF convention is also applied to the only binary file (figures/geometry_parity_355_vs_326.png): raw 95,305 B becomes canonical 95,303 B, so the manifest bytes/sha256 describe a normalized binary, not the stored PNG bytes. Reproducible only by re-applying CRLF->LF to binaries.
fix: Declare a binary exception and hash raw bytes for binaries, or document explicitly that PNG must be normalized before hashing.

claim: Generated setup files are "930 B, 42 lines, sha256 c862aa220bc6f3a9"
finding: 930 B / c862aa is the raw CRLF form written by OpenVSP (generation JSON setup_bytes/setup_sha256); the committed canonical-LF .vspaero files are 888 B / sha256 360618f4... and the manifest records 888 B. README/report do not state that the 930 B figure is the pre-normalization form.
fix: State both forms: raw OpenVSP output 930 B (c862aa) and committed canonical-LF 888 B (360618f4), or quote the manifest value.

claim: Role deliverables are archived verbatim; A3 audit hashes (C6/C8) are reproducible from the package
finding: A3 audited raw CRLF originals (install_provenance 5,147 B / 3da3dc7a; usage 1,546 B / 3bc9b1d1), while the package archives canonical LF versions (5,033 B / 6305eb12; 1,513 B / 34b30863). Additionally A3 checks.log is listed as the audit raw record but is absent from role_reviews/a3/.
fix: Archive the raw CRLF copies (or record both raw and canonical hashes) and either include checks.log or qualify the "archived verbatim" statement.

claim: The compatibility matrix is 28 rows C01-C28 (api_compat_checks.csv)
finding: The CSV contains 29 data rows C01-C29; row C29 is a PASS note on DegenGeom.csv LIFTING_SURFACE/SymCopy/FlipNormal semantics. role_reviews/README.md:7 says "29-item", so the same artifact is counted as 28 and 29 in different files (no missing evidence, C29 is an extra note row).
fix: Update api_compat_matrix.md to 29 rows C01-C29 and align the role_reviews README wording.

claim: "Isolation verified by A3: no User/Machine/Process PATH entry"
finding: A3 facts and install_provenance show User and Process PATH do contain the old OpenVSP 3.26.1 entry (any_355_path_entry=false; path_env_has_openvsp=true). The 3.55 side-install is correctly absent from PATH/registry/site-packages, but the claim as written reads as "no OpenVSP PATH entry at all".
fix: Scope the sentence: "no 3.55 PATH/registry/site-packages entry; the legacy 3.26.1 PATH entry remains but is not used".

claim: Slice noise amplifies the raw area-rule solution by "58x to 18,380x"
finding: The A2 table gives 8.724x at sigma=0.002 m2 and 58.175x at sigma=0.005 m2; text uses the sigma=0.005 value as the lower bound, understating the sigma=0.002 amplification by ~6.7x.
fix: Say "8.7x to 18,380x" or quote the sigma range explicitly (8.724x at 0.002 m2; 58x at 0.005 m2).
